def main() -> None:
    columns = ["call_id", "cik", "sic_division", "portfolio_eligible", "SCRisk", "Resolution",
               "CAR_0_1", "CAR_2_60", "scrisk_zero", "resolution_zero"]
    source = pd.read_csv(SOURCE, usecols=columns, dtype={"cik": str}, low_memory=False)
    eligible = source[source.portfolio_eligible].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
    eligible["tie_key"] = eligible.call_id.map(
        lambda call_id: hashlib.sha256(("portfolio-ties-v1|" + call_id).encode()).hexdigest()
    )
    assert len(eligible) == 52533 and eligible.call_id.is_unique

    nonzero, nonzero_thresholds = winsorize(eligible[~eligible.scrisk_zero].copy().reset_index(drop=True))
    assert len(nonzero) == 31506 and not nonzero.scrisk_zero.any()
    nonzero["SCRisk_quintile"] = equal_count_quintiles(nonzero, "SCRisk_winsor", ["sic_division"])
    nonzero["Resolution_quintile"] = equal_count_quintiles(
        nonzero, "Resolution_winsor", ["sic_division", "SCRisk_quintile"]
    )
    nonzero_tables = deterministic_tables(nonzero)
    render_pdf(
        NONZERO_PDF, nonzero_tables,
        "Modification 1 - zero SCRisk calls excluded",
        f"Nonzero-SCRisk sample: {len(nonzero):,} calls, {nonzero.cik.nunique():,} firms. Variables winsorized at 1% and 99%.",
        "Equal-count SCRisk quintiles within SIC division; Resolution nested within division and SCRisk quintile.",
        False,
    )

    fractional, fractional_thresholds = winsorize(eligible)
    original = {row["variable"]: row for row in csv.DictReader(ORIGINAL_THRESHOLDS.open())}
    for row in fractional_thresholds:
        assert np.isclose(row["lower_threshold"], float(original[row["variable"]]["lower_threshold"]), atol=1e-14)
        assert np.isclose(row["upper_threshold"], float(original[row["variable"]]["upper_threshold"]), atol=1e-14)
    risk_long, joint_long, zero_audit = fractional_assignments(fractional)
    fractional_result_tables = fractional_tables(fractional, risk_long, joint_long)
    render_pdf(
        FRACTIONAL_PDF, fractional_result_tables,
        "Modification 2 - fractional allocation of tied scores",
        f"Full eligible sample: {len(fractional):,} calls, {fractional.cik.nunique():,} firms. Variables winsorized at 1% and 99%.",
        "Tied blocks receive equal proportional membership; masses are equal within each SIC division and nested sort.",
        True,
    )

    manifest = {
        "created_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "source": {"path": str(SOURCE.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha256(SOURCE),
                   "eligible_calls": int(len(eligible)), "eligible_firms": int(eligible.cik.nunique())},
        "shared_method": {
            "winsorization": "linear 1st/99th percentiles within each variant's analysis sample; originals retained in source",
            "scrisk_sort": "ascending within SIC division; matching quintiles pooled across divisions",
            "resolution_sort": "ascending within SIC division and SCRisk portfolio",
            "means": "call-weighted for nonzero variant; fractional-membership-weighted for tied-score variant",
            "uncertainty": "95% t intervals using one-way CIK-clustered weighted score sums",
            "controlled_regressions": False,
        },
        "nonzero_scrisk": {
            "pdf": str(NONZERO_PDF.relative_to(ROOT)), "pdf_sha256": sha256(NONZERO_PDF),
            "calls": int(len(nonzero)), "firms": int(nonzero.cik.nunique()),
            "excluded_zero_scrisk_calls": int(eligible.scrisk_zero.sum()),
            "winsorization_thresholds": nonzero_thresholds,
            "scrisk_quintile_counts": [int(row["contributing_calls"]) for row in nonzero_tables["car_0_1_by_scrisk"]],
        },
        "fractional_ties": {
            "pdf": str(FRACTIONAL_PDF.relative_to(ROOT)), "pdf_sha256": sha256(FRACTIONAL_PDF),
            "calls": int(len(fractional)), "firms": int(fractional.cik.nunique()),
            "winsorization_thresholds": fractional_thresholds,
            "zero_scrisk_membership_by_division": zero_audit,
            "risk_effective_mass": [float(row["effective_n"]) for row in fractional_result_tables["car_0_1_by_scrisk"]],
            "joint_effective_mass": [float(row["effective_n"]) for row in fractional_result_tables["car_0_1_heatmap"]],
            "risk_assignment_rows": int(len(risk_long)), "joint_assignment_rows": int(len(joint_long)),
        },
        "implementation": {"path": str(Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha256(Path(__file__))},
    }
    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({
        "nonzero_pdf": str(NONZERO_PDF), "nonzero_calls": len(nonzero),
        "fractional_pdf": str(FRACTIONAL_PDF), "fractional_calls": len(fractional),
        "manifest": str(MANIFEST),
    }, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
